issue_context.title: add support for `arm64` architecture for watchOS devices (Xcode 14)
issue_context.body: ### Description of the feature request: Xcode 14 adds `arm64` architecture for watchOS devices: Currently Bazel [only supports `armv7k` and `arm64_32`](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/26509a7b6c684adcab34d00ef765f069f4c8ac13/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/rules/apple/ApplePlatform.java#L51-L52). When you would like to build for watchOS device using `arm64` architecture (`watchOS_arm64`) currently it will get [incorrectly mapped to watchOS simulator](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/26509a7b6c684adcab34d00ef765f069f4c8ac13/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/rules/apple/ApplePlatform.java#L141-L142) which already [supports `arm64` architecture](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/26509a7b6c684adcab34d00ef765f069f4c8ac13/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/rules/apple/ApplePlatform.java#L49-L50). I've already submitted PR (#16181) with proposed changes: * Adds `watchos_arm64` to supported watchOS device architectures. * Renames `watchos_arm64` to `watchos_sim_arm64` (following the convention as for tvOS and iOS). ### What underlying problem are you trying to solve with this feature? I would like to build in Xcode 14 for watchOS devices with `arm64` architecture. ### Which operating system are you running Bazel on? macOS Monterey 12.5.1 ### What is the output of `bazel info release`? release 5.3.0 ### If `bazel info release` returns `development version` or `(@non-git)`, tell us how you built Bazel. _No response_ ### What's the output of `git remote get-url origin; git rev-parse master; git rev-parse HEAD` ? _No response_ ### Have you found anything relevant by searching the web? _No response_ ### Any other information, logs, or outputs that you want to share? _No response_
comments:
This CPU was added in https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/ce611646969cfe72ae5e22083708684eae11e478 but I just submitted rules support to cover it https://github.com/bazelbuild/apple_support/pull/289 https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_apple/pull/2342

if you still see issues with those please file an issue!

review_comments: Since this is a breaking change, we should add something to the release notes at the minimum, though maybe we don't change the name at all? People can have existing configuration that uses `watchos_arm64` to mean the simulator, and some rulesets would have to do a version check or something similar to get the right version of this: https://github.com/buildbuddy-io/rules_xcodeproj/blob/47d9510b64878ae1893d355cbf134d6a4b6eb715/xcodeproj/internal/xcodeproj_rule.bzl#L490-L493

> Since this is a breaking change, we should add something to the release notes at the minimum, though maybe we don't change the name at all?

I think breaking change would be suitable for 6.0.0 release? 👀 I wanted to be consistent with the other names, otherwise it can get confusing.
It's the best time to break it, yes, but I was also starting how it's tricky for rulesets to do things based on the bazel version.
